releases.name: v0.27.0 — The Corners of the Mouth
releases.body:
## What's New

### Concurrency Safety
- Lock all state writers with `withFileLock` + atomic rename
- `saveBlackboxState`, `_seedOrRepairModelTiers`, `writeSessionRecord` now safe under concurrent OpenCode instances
- Remove duplicate `updateState` in cascade.ts

### Rotation Bounds
- `appendJsonlWithRotation`: lock + atomic rename on trim
- Rotate `.session-bridges.jsonl` (1500 lines), `.state-corruption-log` (500)
- Rotate `cascade-audit.jsonl` (5000), `session-events/*` (200)
- Wire scratchpad global count/byte caps + prune in `applyDecadence`
- Cap global-learning lexicon maps at 2000 entries

### Footer Fixes
- Fix debounce to check text length, not just 200ms time window
- Streaming re-paints now work correctly
- `cascadeDepth` uses persisted resolution depth

### Cascade Fixes
- Remove `default_agent` override in `syncControlSettings`
- Task-tool interception handles routing without touching opencode.json
- Regime cache: 60s/3-turn TTL with stress bypass

### Uninstall
- `npx vibeostheog uninstall` — removes plugin, agents, launchd, cron, VIBEOS_HOME, npm package

## Breaking Changes
- `default_agent` no longer overridden — users must set it manually
